title: VynixShader
description: A lightweight Minecraft shader focused on clean visuals, grace lighting, and smooth performance.
body:
# VynixShader

**VynixShader** is a modern Minecraft shader designed to make your world look better without sacrificing performance. It enhances lighting, shadows, water, skies, and colors while keeping the game smooth for everyday gameplay and PvP.

## ✨ Features

* 🌅 Improved dynamic lighting
* ☀️ Beautiful sunrise and sunset colors
* 🌊 Enhanced water reflections and waves
* ☁️ Better clouds and sky rendering
* 🌿 More vibrant yet natural colors
* 🌙 Improved night atmosphere
* ⚡ Lightweight and optimized for higher FPS
* 🎮 Great for Survival, Creative, and PvP

## 🎯 Goals

VynixShader aims to provide a clean and balanced visual experience. Instead of pushing your GPU to its limits, it focuses on delivering attractive graphics with excellent performance on a wide range of systems.

## 📦 Compatibility

* Minecraft **1.21.x** and newer (depending on release)
* Requires **Iris Shaders** or **OptiFine** (where supported)

## 💬 Feedback

Found a bug or have a suggestion? We'd love to hear your feedback! Your reports help improve future versions of VynixShader.

Enjoy Minecraft with a fresh new look using **VynixShader**.
